title: Gentle Design canvas chrome
brief: Redesign the Gentle Design canvas toolbar, comments panel and artboard headers: clearer hierarchy, SVG icons, keyboard shortcuts, design tokens

artboards.title: Three-zone bar
artboards.tradeoff: Lowest-risk evolution of today's layout and palette; the canvas keeps a full-width bar

artboards.title: Floating dock
artboards.tradeoff: Canvas gets the whole window with a minimap; floating chrome can cover artboards

artboards.title: Brand rail
artboards.tradeoff: Unifies with the installer brand and adds a handoff timeline; biggest change and least canvas width
